Germany
  • JAC Recruitment Germany was established in Germany in 2019 and has three offices in Düsseldorf, Frankfurt and Munich.

    Our dedicated teams of highly professional consultants are committed to delivering expert recruitment services to both local and multinational companies in Germany.

Recruitment Services

Management, Specialists, and Global Talent

JAC RecruitmentManagement, Specialists, and Global Talent

In Germany, we have particular strengths in the manufacturing, trade, and logistics sectors. Additionally, we have expertise in sourcing multilingual professionals and global talent.
